program.name: Long Complex
program.subject: Kettlebell complexes
program.blurb: Two kettlebell complexes a day: one long chain, then a shorter one.
program.about: Two complexes, each a chain of bell moves done without putting the bell down. The first is four moves long and the second three, both round after round. Two days alternate, one led by the clean and one by the swing. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for a heavier bell.
program.split: Two complexes a day, A / B
